## Requires Home Assistant 2026.5 or newer

This release requires Home Assistant 2026.5 or newer. HACS/Marketplace does not
offer it to older installations, so update Home Assistant first to receive it.
Integration versions you already have installed keep working.

The integration now supports the Home Assistant releases from about the last six
months, and the minimum moves forward as Home Assistant publishes new releases.

[Supported Home Assistant versions](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass#supported-home-assistant-versions)

## New: Refresh sensors and binary sensors on request

Calling the `homeassistant.update_entity` action on a sensor or binary sensor
now reads its current value from the System Access Point, as it already did for
lights, switches, and other entities. Entities still don't poll; the refresh
runs only when requested.

This gives a workaround for the weather station's wind speed, which stops
updating shortly after Home Assistant starts
([#138](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass/issues/138),
[#166](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass/issues/166)):
an automation can refresh the wind speed sensor periodically.

[Refreshing entities on request](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass#refreshing-entities-on-request)
